court_name.description: Formal court heading. Leave as [रिक्त] if unknown.

plaintiffs.description: Plaintiff details properly formatted for the party block. No extra words.

defendants.description: Defendant details properly formatted for the party block. No extra words.

nature_of_suit.description: Main title/nature of the suit (e.g., स्थायी निषेधाज्ञा का वाद).

factual_averments.description: Formal Hindi drafting of the facts. MUST NOT contain numbers (1, 2) or 'यह कि'. MUST NOT contain requested reliefs.

cause_of_action.description: Drafted cause of action paragraph without numbering or 'यह कि'.

jurisdiction.description: Drafted jurisdiction paragraph without numbering or 'यह कि'.

valuation_and_court_fee.description: Drafted valuation/court fee paragraph. Leave blank if not required.

prayer.description: Drafted relief clauses. E.g., '(क) यह कि प्रतिवादी को...'.
